proposal.summary: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit SDK contains a bug in cuobjdump that may cause a null-pointer dereference, resulting in a limited denial of service.
proposal.cwe_quote: The application does not properly handle unexpected or invalid input, leading to a null-pointer dereference.

AV.quote: A local user running the tool against an ill-formed binary may cause a null-pointer dereference.

A.quote: may result in a limited denial of service.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the handling of input in cuobjdump to prevent null-pointer dereferences.
